definitions.explanation: Describes a person, attitude, or position that avoids extremes and favors a balanced, restrained approach. Commonly used in political and social contexts.

examples.japanese: {穏健|おんけん}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{穏健|おんけん}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}っている→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{穏健|おんけん}な⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧ことで、⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}とう→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧とした。
examples.english: They tried to maintain social stability by pursuing moderate reforms.

notes:
Describes a stance or character that avoids extremism and favors moderation. Frequently used in political discourse to describe positions, factions, or leaders who favor gradual change over radical action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {穏健|おんけん}{派|は}: moderate faction/wing
- {穏健|おんけん}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: a moderate stance
- {穏健|おんけん}な⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧: a moderate course/policy line
- {穏健|おんけん}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧: a mild-mannered personality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧: calm, gentle — describes personality or atmosphere more broadly; less political
- ⟦{温厚|おんこう}→温厚：18221_onkou⟧: warm and gentle — focused on personal character rather than political stance
- ⟦{中庸|ちゅうよう}→中庸：20181_chuuyou⟧: the golden mean — a philosophical concept of moderation, more abstract
- ⟦{過激|かげき}→過激：14325_kageki⟧: radical, extreme — the opposite of {穏健|おんけん}
